source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check the healthy LED
2. Make any error log and check the Healthy LED
3. Clear the error log and check the Healthy LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
(Depends on project design)
1. Power-on and Healthy (Green): The system is powered on and healthy.
2. System fault (Amber): System failures, encompassing scenarios such as fan failures, device overheating, and PSU failures.
The Healthy LED changes to green or off once all critical
failures have been successfully rectified.
3. Off (None): None

deepseek_columns.ai_commands:
-- Healthy LED: trigger/clear an injectable error via OOB IPMI and read SEL; the Healthy LED color (green=healthy/amber=fault) must be seen by a person.
ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel elist 2>&1 | tail -20
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the SEL tail + BMC health status so the user correlates amber/green Healthy LED; LED color is operator-visual.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: only reads SEL/health; LED color is human visual - agent must not fabricate it.

original_test_intent: Visually validate the project Healthy LED transitions from healthy to a defined fault state and back after the fault is rectified, correlated with BMC health/SEL.
original_method: An engineer observes the LED, introduces and clears an approved fault, and compares physical indication with BMC health/logs.
manual_activity: The core acceptance is physical LED observation before, during and after an engineer-controlled fault; the agent may only collect/correlate telemetry and media.
safety_requirements: Do not create an arbitrary fault or clear unrelated historical logs.
Protect storage, power and thermal domains according to selected stimulus.
Preserve pre-existing evidence; no automatic retry.
Verify fault removal and full recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Collect BMC health, SEL and system telemetry and organize engineer-supplied LED evidence.
Do not inject physical fault, certify LED color or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/apply/clear fault and visually observe LED states.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only SEL/health is supporting evidence only; it cannot trigger an unspecified fault or prove LED color.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual LED method and use safe read-only health/SEL collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Healthy/fault/cleared phases, project colors and 10/5 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Choose one bounded representative fault, capture baseline LED/health, inject and correlate amber/SEL, clear it and prove the project-defined recovery state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project-specific health aggregation and front panel.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project health LED priority and fault-management specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces `any error log` with a defined safe causal fault.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains physical indication while preventing log-only false stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault injection may affect availability or data.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific colors and fault priority control; document selected fault and do not extrapolate to all failures.
expected_evidence: Healthy LED photo and BMC state
Fault LED photo plus causal SEL/health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is broad but coherent; `any error log` needs a project-selected causal stimulus rather than implying any textual log changes health.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Missing project matrix and stimulus are inputs. Physical observation makes this MANUAL ONLY, not BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains SEL support and visual boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to MANUAL ONLY because LED observation is core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents arbitrary fault or evidence clearing.

review_improvement: Replaces non-causal error-log wording with a bounded fault-to-health-to-LED transition.
independent_technical_reasoning: The health aggregator and physical LED circuit are what the case accepts; software telemetry can corroborate but cannot itself establish the observed color or front-panel behavior.
